correctness.rationale: At g=v=c>0, the two linear equations have exact post-pulse solution Te(τ)=Y e^{-cτ}, T0(τ)=e^{-cτ}(X+kYτ), with E=e^{-cT}, Y=Λ/(1−E), X=kΛTE/(1−E)^2. The affine one-period map has upper-triangular linear part [[E,kTE],[0,E]], spectral radius E<1; the fixed point is unique and globally attracting (including the non-diagonalizable repeated-eigenvalue case). Both jump and continuity boundaries hold. Integrated balance gives ∫Te=Λ/c and ∫T0=kΛ/c², yielding kΛ/(c²T). Independent numerical reproduction at a nontrivial (k,c,Λ,T)=(0.71,1.23,0.53,1.7) checks periodicity/mean; Mu–Lo's exact k=g=v=T=1, Λ=.2 case yields mean .2. No claim about ecological simulation correctness.
